verification.notes: 19 WebSearch calls used. XC40/EX40 BEV trunk: Volvo DE official EX40 spec page (https://www.volvocars.com/de/cars/ex40-electric/specifications/) lists 'Gepäckraumvolumen hinter zweiter Sitzreihe: 410 l', 'maximal hinter erster Sitzreihe: 1 400 l', frunk 31 l -> EX40 410/1400 confirmed by manufacturer. Early XC40 Recharge P8 414/1290 confirmed by insideevs.de 2021 test; 2022-23 Twin 419/1295 consistent with evspecifications/vehiclesizes; MY2024 Single Motor (RWD) 452/1328 consistent with a German Autotest (regensburger-nachrichten). The differences are real data revisions across model years, not errors; no Volvo VDA figure for the pre-2024 BEV found. A 2020 launch report (driving.co.uk) cited 413 l for the Recharge (vs ADAC 414) - not strong enough to correct. XC60 2008-2013 now confirmed by ADAC (https://www.adac.de/rund-ums-fahrzeug/autokatalog/marken-modelle/volvo/xc60/1generation/214512, D5 AWD 11/08-04/09): 4627 x 1891 x 1713 mm, wheelbase 2774, trunk 495/1455 l, 185 PS -> all pre-facelift values confirmed; confidence can be raised. XC40 Gen1 dims 4425/1652/2702 and ~1.86 m width confirmed (carexpert/angurten). C40 413/1205 + 31 l frunk confirmed (evspecifications, incl. Single Motor). EX30 318/1000 l confirmed by Volvo's own spec pages (318 l second row up, 1000 l max seats folded; 904 l only third-party); wheelbase 2650, length 4233 confirmed; width given as 1836 (RWD)/1837 (AWD) by AutoScout24/Carwow vs 1838 in data - minor, not corrected without manufacturer source. XC60 Gen2 4688/1902/1658/2865 confirmed (carsales); 483/1410 confirmed (autoplenum). XC60 2025 facelift: length 4708, 483/1543 (B5, autoplenum) and T8 468/1528 (autotijd) confirmed; height 1655 not confirmed (autoplenum 1650, autotijd T6 1656) - left unchanged. Volvo's own non-VDA marketing figures (XC40 460/1336, XC40 B4 'max' 569/1432, XC60 505) use a different method and were not used as corrections. XC40 facelift length 4440 vs 4425 in ultimatespecs (B4 2023) - ADAC data already reflects the 4425->4440 change; not corrected.
